description: Source code for a server module in the Playwright MCP SDK, handling server creation, request handling, heartbeat, and client info management.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the server using a specified backend factory and transport.

methods.name: wrapInProcess
methods.description: Wraps a backend in an in-process transport.

methods.name: wrapInClient
methods.description: Creates a client connected to an in-process server backend.

methods.name: createServer
methods.description: Creates and configures a new MCP server instance with request handlers.

methods.name: initializeServer
methods.description: Initializes server with client info and starts heartbeat if enabled.

methods.name: startHeartbeat
methods.description: Starts periodic ping to keep the server alive and detect disconnection.

methods.name: addServerListener
methods.description: Adds event listeners to server events such as 'close' or 'initialized'.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server, either via in-process or HTTP based on options.

methods.name: firstRootPath
methods.description: Returns the file system path of the first root in client info.

methods.name: allRootPaths
methods.description: Returns all file system paths of roots in client info.

methods.name: mergeTextParts
methods.description: Merges consecutive text parts in a CallToolResult into a single text block.
